name: Continuous check for events
hint: To ensure that you don´t miss an event you continuously check for it in a forever loop.
instruction: To ensure that you don´t miss an event you continuously check for it in a forever loop.

examples.label: Elegant code
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
forever
if <key (left arrow v) pressed?> then //⇦  👍
change [x v] by (-1)
end
